description: Current perpetual funding rate for one coin (hourly rate plus an annualized estimate), merged across providers, with its 24h and 7d trajectory AND the underlying 8h-bucket series. Positive means longs pay shorts. The trajectory is the point: the same +6% annualized reads as post-flush relief if it fell from +40% and as shorts capitulating if it rose from -20%. The series carries the shape a trailing delta flattens away — a steady drift and a spike that retraced give the same 24h change off opposite tapes — plus the window's own low/high, so the current rate can be judged against where it has actually been rather than an absolute threshold. A 1y line ranks the current rate against a year of daily closes (percentile, low/median/high with dates), so 'high' means high for this coin, not just for the week. Set 'points' to trim the series (omit for the full ~10-day window; 0 to suppress it).

points.description: How many of the newest 8h buckets to emit. Omit for the full window (30 points ~ 10 days); 0 suppresses the series and returns the summary only.

name: funding_current

baseline1y.description: The headline rate ranked against a year of daily closes of the OI-weighted rate; low, median and high are annualized percent

atOrAboveMs.description: Newest day at or above the current rate, Unix epoch milliseconds; absent when it tops the year

available.description: False when there is nothing to rank against; note says why

high.description: Year's highest daily close, annualized percent

highMs.description: Day of the high, Unix epoch milliseconds

low.description: Year's lowest daily close, annualized percent

lowMs.description: Day of the low, Unix epoch milliseconds

median.description: Year's median daily close, annualized percent

percentile.description: Rank among the year's settled daily closes, 0-100

basis.description: Which leg the headline is: OI-weighted across venues, one venue's settled rate, or the cross-venue median

found.description: False when no provider lists the symbol; only symbol is then present

ratePctPerHour.description: Headline funding rate, percent per hour (0.001 = 0.001%/h); positive means longs pay shorts

series.description: The funding series; absent when points=0 or the history feed is down

forming.description: Bucket still open: a running estimate the feed rewrites until it closes

timeMs.description: Bucket open time, Unix epoch milliseconds

trajectory.description: The rate now against 24h and 7d ago, from the 8h series; empty when the history feed is down or too short

nowAnnualizedPct.description: Annualized rate at the newest point, percent

priorAnnualizedPct.description: Annualized rate at the start of the window, percent
